mod.name: Chat Improvements
mod.description: Improves the chat box with longer messages and better editing.
config.section.messages.name: Messages
config.section.messages.desc: How much text a message can hold, and how far back the chat remembers.
config.section.editing.name: Editing
config.section.editing.desc: Moving the cursor and selecting text inside the chat box.
config.section.appearance.name: Appearance
config.section.appearance.desc: What the chat box shows alongside your text.
config.section.links.name: Links
config.section.links.desc: How web links in chat messages behave.
config.section.keybinds.name: Keybinds
config.section.keybinds.desc: Shortcuts used while the chat box is open.
config.maxMessageLength.name: Max Message Length
config.maxMessageLength.tooltip: The maximum number of characters allowed in a chat message.
config.maxChatHistory.name: Max Chat History
config.maxChatHistory.tooltip: Maximum number of messages to store in chat history. Higher values use more memory but let you scroll further back. (Default: 100)
config.enableHorizontalScrolling.name: Enable Horizontal Scrolling
config.enableHorizontalScrolling.tooltip: Enable horizontal scrolling when typing long messages.
config.enableCursorControl.name: Enable Cursor Control
config.enableCursorControl.tooltip: Enable cursor control (arrow keys) inside the chat box.
config.enableMessageColorButton.name: Enable Message Color Button
config.enableMessageColorButton.tooltip: Enable the message color button inside the chat box.
config.allowUrlClickWhenChatClosed.name: Open Links With Chat Closed
config.allowUrlClickWhenChatClosed.toolt: Allow URLs to be clicked without opening chat.
config.linkClickBehavior.name: Link Click Behavior
config.linkClickBehavior.tooltip: What happens when you click a link in chat. Copying is safer, since links come from other players.
config.keyRepeatInitialDelay.name: Key Repeat Initial Delay
config.keyRepeatInitialDelay.tooltip: Initial delay before key repeat starts when holding a key.
config.keyRepeatDelay.name: Key Repeat Delay
config.keyRepeatDelay.tooltip: Delay between repeated cursor movements when holding a key.
config.copyKeybind.name: Copy Keybind
config.cutKeybind.name: Cut Keybind
config.pasteKeybind.name: Paste Keybind
config.selectAllKeybind.name: Select All Keybind
config.undoKeybind.name: Undo Keybind
config.redoKeybind.name: Redo Keybind
